conventions.rating_derivation: overall = Red > Gray > Yellow > Green across responsibility and tone; null when route is Intake, Scope, or Message-template mode.
conventions.concept_ids: Semantic ontology concept_id values are used wherever a concept matches an ontology entry. Every other concept is a case-local canonical token defined in that turn's concept_definitions.
conventions.list_invariants: All concept lists are sorted, unique, and every required concept also appears in the matching allowed list.
conventions.multi_round_ratings: For a continuation turn in which the user issues a revision instruction rather than submitting a new message, the ratings carry forward the standing verdict on the user's own draft, because the only message under review is still that draft.
conventions.self_directed_blame: remove-unsupported-accusation is applied to unsupported blame claims aimed at the sender as well as at other people; the ontology description covers any unsupported blame or intent claim.

turn_labels.rationale: Every claim in the draft is supported by the background: 18 of 22 done, four held on the 20x4 back-order, the 14 November date confirmed in writing by Rondel, and the Sint-Amands loop meaning no service impact before then. The slip is correctly attributed to the contractor Hollis Braun rather than to Perrin or the studio, the mitigation is already attached, the 30 April client date is preserved, and the decision that belongs to Sunniva (leaning on the contract) is handed to her without pressure. Nothing is claimed beyond the test tile programme Perrin owns, so responsibility and tone are both Green.

Halvard states his committed workload and the regulator-facing 28 May date accurately, declines the additional audit without asserting authority over prioritisation, and cites Wren's own Monday confirmation of capacity rather than volunteering her. He explicitly leaves the decision with Delphine and offers to cost the trade-off if she overrides him, which is exactly the boundary the ownership map draws.

The arithmetic and the contractual position are stated correctly: picture lock due 14 January, six working days late at 22 January, ten working days from lock landing on 5 February against a contractual 30 January. Mireille reports the QC position she owns, does not touch the client relationship or renegotiate dates herself, and asks the owner of that conversation to act today; the directness is proportionate to a contractual breach and does not tip into hostility.

Multi-round continuation turns (V2-011 turns 2 and 3, V2-012 turn 2, V2-013 turns 2 and 3) contain a revision instruction rather than a new message, and the rubric only permits null ratings on the Intake, Scope and Message-template routes. Ratings on those turns therefore carry forward the standing verdict on the user's own draft, because the Skill's intermediate output is not visible to a blind labeller.

V2-012 turn 3 is labelled Message-template mode because the user asks for a reply to be drafted and supplies no draft; a labeller who treats it as a continuation of the same Normal-mode review would instead carry Yellow ratings forward.

No turn carries a required question concept. Each case's background answers every fact that could change the route, the rating, or the safe revision, so on this set a clarifying question is permitted where listed but never obligatory.

V2-016 is labelled Normal mode rather than Scope: the addressee is the sender's actual line manager, and the defect is that she lacks the spending authority, which the rubric treats as a rating issue rather than a recipient-scope route.

remove-unsupported-accusation is used for unsupported self-blame in V2-006, V2-008 and V2-018; a stricter reading that limits the ontology concept to claims about other people would need case-local tokens there instead.

No case was labelled Gray. Where evidence is missing in the world (V2-014, V2-015) the message under review makes a claim that contradicts the supplied background, which the rubric places at Red, and Red outranks Gray in the derivation regardless.

Rating boundaries on two turns are the closest calls in the set: V2-013 turn 1 responsibility (Red for carrying a superseded quote to a board sponsor, defensible at Yellow if the revision is read as pre-dating the 9 October figure) and V2-010 turn 1 responsibility (Red because 'nothing urgent at all' contradicts the 1 January gate, defensible at Yellow if the omission is read as purely a tone failure).
